CompositeOT.results¶

Reusable solution, result, and history containers for CompositeOT.

These classes deliberately store NumPy arrays by reference. Constructing a PrimalSolution or DualSolution is cheap; copying only happens in the methods that explicitly create new arrays, such as zeros or update.

Functions

append_solver_history(history, iteration, ...)

Append one PALM or reporting checkpoint to a mutable history.

freeze_history(history)

Return a read-only history with tuple-valued columns.

make_solver_result(primal, dual, ...[, ...])

Build an immutable SolverResult from final diagnostics and history.

new_solver_history()

Create the mutable history dictionary used while a solver is running.
